sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: Heine managed to master the power of the mystic sword, and brought the armored man back to his senses with help from the young man. However, they would unexpectedly be attacked by a gigantic shadow shortly afterwards. In the middle of their heated battle, a colossal divine being sprung from his mystic sword and defeated the shadow, as if responding to Heine's own will. At that moment he had a vision of himself fighting in a strange land. With the battle finally finished, the mystic sword let go of his hand, but he picked it right back up. Having grown curious about his origins following this experience, he decided to go in search for answers with his sword in hand.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Graceful Blade Heine |bf2 = true }} '''Heine''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== Heine managed to master the power of the mystic sword, and brought the armored man back to his senses with help from the young man. However, they would unexpectedly be attacked by a gigantic shadow shortly afterwards. In the middle of their heated battle, a colossal divine being sprung from his mystic sword and defeated the shadow, as if responding to Heine's own will. At that moment he had a vision of himself fighting in a strange land. With the battle finally finished, the mystic sword let go of his hand, but he picked it right back up. Having grown curious about his origins following this experience, he decided to go in search for answers with his sword in hand. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Heine |element = Earth |image1 = Navi chara bf2 131 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 131 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 131 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 131 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 131 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 131 5.png |image6note = Hurt |image7 = Navi chara bf2 135 0.png |image7note = }} {{CharacterImage |name = Heine with Sword |element = Earth |image1 = Navi chara bf2 132 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 132 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 132 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 132 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 132 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 132 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
